Kaaviokuva torninosturista sivulta. Pyst: Schematic side view of a tower crane. A vertical tower whose axis is marked with a dashed line. At the top of the tower a horizontal jib: a long jib to the right, along which the trolley moves, and a short counter-jib to the left, with a concrete counterweight of mass m v hanging at its end. The distance of the centre of mass of the counterweight from the axis of the tower is r v. The centre of mass of the jib, of mass m p, is marked on the jib to the right of the tower at distance r p. A load of mass m hangs on a cable from the trolley at distance r from the axis of the tower.
Kaksi kuvaa. Vasemmalla tilannekuva sivu: Two pictures. On the left a side view of the situation: a part of the jib at the top, the axis of the tower as a dashed line on the left. The cable from the trolley is tilted so that the load is farther from the axis of the tower than the trolley. Next to the load an orange acceleration arrow a n points horizontally towards the axis of the tower. On the right the free-body diagram of the load, the load as a rectangle tilted along the cable: the weight G straight down from the centre and the tension S of the cable from the upper surface along the cable upwards and towards the axis of the tower. The tension is slightly longer than the weight, and its vertical component is equal to the weight. Separately an orange acceleration arrow a n to the left. The angle has been drawn much larger than in the problem so that the arrows can be told apart.
